depends_on: Selberg/Brun upper bound #{p <= x : p+h prime} << prod_{q|h}(1+1/q) x/log^2 x uniform in even h (Halberstam-Richert, Sieve Methods, Thm 3.11)
notes: Mathlib proof det_distMat: StrictMono x -> 2 <= n -> det(|x i - x j|)_{i,j<n} = (-1)^(n-1) 2^(n-2) (x(n-1) - x 0) prod_{i<n-1}(x(i+1) - x i) over any linearly ordered comm ring; A187011_formula: same for a n with x = Nat.nth Nat.Prime; A187011_sign: 2 <= n -> 0 < (-1)^(n-1) a n. Outside Lean: growth part |a(n)|^(1/n) -> infinity, equivalent by the formula to the mean of log(prime gap) -> infinity; proved by hand from the uniform Selberg/Brun prime-pair upper bound (at most O(H log H n/log n) of the first n gaps are <= H). Not reducible to Chebyshev bounds alone.

sources.cite: R. B. Bapat, S. J. Kirkland, M. Neumann, On distance matrices and Laplacians, Linear Algebra Appl. 401 (2005) 193-209
R. L. Graham, H. O. Pollak, On the addressing problem for loop switching, Bell Syst. Tech. J. 50 (1971)

prior_art.note: Sign part is the weighted-path case of the Bapat-Kirkland-Neumann tree formula; growth part a routine sieve corollary; no prior proof of the A187011 conjecture found.
